contract.object: Densely defined closed generator A:D(A)⊂H→H of a strongly continuous linear semigroup T(t) on a complex Hilbert space H.
contract.type_domain: Complex Hilbert space; linear C0-semigroup; generator domain D(A) is retained under the shift A-aI.
contract.conditions: A generates T(t); s0(A) uses uniform resolvent boundedness on closed half-planes strictly to the right of the spectral bound; the reverse inequality imports right-half-plane Gearhart–Prüss–Huang.
contract.quantity: Semigroup growth bound omega_0(T) and uniform-resolvent abscissa s_0(A).
contract.claim: omega_0(T)=s_0(A), hence exponential stability iff s_0(A)<0.
contract.limits: No Banach export, no equality with spectral bound in general, no peak/Kreiss control, no nonlinear or nonautonomous export, no Lyapunov-metric construction, no closure of general P9.

sources.locator: Gearhart (1978), spectral criterion for contraction semigroups on Hilbert space; source component of the Hilbert resolvent/stability bridge.
Prüss (1984), On the spectrum of C0-semigroups; Hilbert-space resolvent/growth-bound theorem used for the right-half-plane formulation.
